newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sime Singapore sees full year rising.
newsitem.headline: Sime Singapore sees full year rising.

text.p: Sime Singapore Ltd said on Friday it expected its 1996/97 full year results to be significantly better than the previous year.

Sime said it expected full year results to be "significantly better than that achieved in 1995/96", reporting a leap in half year profit of 241 percent to Singapore $17.4 million for the six months to December 31, 1996.
The surge was attributed to recovery in the company's motor dealership, property and packaging divisions and a lower effective tax rate after tax losses were brought forward.
Vehicle sales were higher with the division reporting good profits against a loss in the previous year, Sime said.
